Excel workbook generation failed due to #N/A errors in calculated cells, likely caused by broken lookup ranges or missing source data.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats tests failed with multiple AssertionError messages. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned '#N/A' instead of the expected numeric values (e.g., H12 expected 472.4, H35 expected -7.0). This indicates that the openpyxl-generated formulas or data lookups are failing to resolve within the 'Task' worksheet.
